narrative_vs_numbers.point: Net profit reached a record Rs 26,218 crore in Sep 2026 (Q2 FY27), up 19.9% YoY, matching strong profit narratives.
Total business aggregated 115 trillion rupees with advances crossing 52 trillion rupees in Sep 2026, confirming growth claims.
Equity increased to Rs 671,592 crore in Sep 2026 alongside a reduced D/E ratio of 1.1.

bull: PAT grew 19.9% YoY to Rs 26,218 crore in Sep 2026.
Total business reached 115 trillion rupees with advances exceeding 52 trillion rupees.
ROE stands at 15.4% and ROCE at 6.13%, supporting management's 15% ROE goal.
bear: Borrowings remain high at Rs 741,291 crore as of Sep 2026.
Quarterly revenue growth shows some deceleration compared to historical highs.
Operating cash flow conversion metrics remain low over multi-year periods.
